title: TokenStream stability & regression-watch for multi-GPU TP/PP throughput
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Build a robust TokenStream stability benchmark and automated regression-watch for distributed inference across tensor/pipeline parallel configurations. This ticket scopes a reproducible harness that measures tokens/sec, p95/p99 latencies, and detects regressions across multi-node TP/PP topologies. The harness must support synthetic traffic, replay traces (microburst and long-tail), KV-cache warmups, and configurable batch/sequence distributions. Results should feed the Console dashboards and an automated weekly CI regression job with alerting on statistical drift.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can run end-to-end on 2/4/8 GPU clusters with TP:1-4 and PP:1-8 permutations and produce reproducible artifacts
Metrics captured per-run: tokens/sec, p50/p90/p95/p99 latencies, error-rate, token-efficiency (tokens/sec/GPU), GPU util, peak GPU memory
Regression detector (EWMA + CUSUM) configured with tunable sensitivity and documented false-positive rate targets
Automated weekly job executes baseline vs current kernel/model variants and creates an alert ticket if p95 regression > 10% or tokens/sec drop > 8% sustained over 3 runs
Integration with Console: per-run CSV/JSON export and perf dashboard link present
End-to-end run reproducible via Docker compose/k8s manifest and associated README
steps: Design benchmark config schema (topologies, load profiles, model variants, quantization flags)
Implement distributed runner orchestration (k8s Jobs + short-lived VM path for Dedicated)
Extend load generator to support token-level replay and synthetic microburst traces
Instrument runtime to emit per-request token counts and latency percentiles with tags for TP/PP configuration
Implement regression detector service (EWMA + CUSUM + bootstrap baseline) and CI integration
Wire results to Console dashboards and add a webhook for automatic issue creation on alert
current_progress: 2025-11-15: Ticket created. Initial scoping with Applied ML and Infra. Identified need for both synthetic and replay traffic.
2025-11-18: Prototype load generator updated to support sequence-length distributions and KV-cache warmup phase. Tested locally against single-node run.
2025-11-20: Dockerized distributed runner POC completed (k8s Job + headless service). Added experiment harness for TP/PP matrix execution.
2025-11-22: Capturing additional telemetry: per-token emit implemented in runtime (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1987). Requires small kernel tag addition.

2025-11-24: Regression detector initial implementation (EWMA + CUSUM) landed in throughput-harness repo. Hooked to experimental CI pipeline for nightly runs (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/throughput-harness/pull/1234). Observed a high false-positive rate on 1-shot microburst traces; tuning required.
metrics_target: p95 latency target for 512-token sequences: < 120ms per-token-step (amortized across pipeline)
Regression alert thresholds: p95 increase > 10% OR tokens/sec decrease > 8% (sustained across 3 runs)
False positive rate for regression detector: < 5% over a 30-day window on synthetic and replay workloads
